_meta: Canonical English catalog. Holds every translatable string in the core; tr.json is a full mirror. Missing keys in any other locale fall back to these values (per-key). Before it runs, EVERY captured payload passes the PHI/secret fail-safe gate
(Article 4 & 13): tool I/O and base64 blobs included. Capture is OFF by default.

cli.init.next_steps:
You're set up. Three things to try next:
  1. konsey doctor              — prove which providers are actually reachable
  2. konsey run "<task>"         — put the council to work (evidence-weighted, audited)
  3. konsey enable automation    — opt in so it self-continues + recovers stalled runs
Nothing runs in the background until you opt in (Article 14).
cli.init.welcome:
Welcome to konsey — a multi-agent council that distributes BOTH the work and the
decision across your AI CLIs, evidence-weighted and append-only-audited. This sets up a
local profile (language · posture · owner · optional data regime) in ~30s. Nothing leaves
this machine; re-run `konsey init --reconfigure` any time.
cli.init.preset_preamble:
Posture — how much konsey may touch your system (changeable later via `konsey config set preset`):
  advisory   : one provider, read-only — recommend, never write.
  balanced   : full council, no autonomous writes (safe default).
  autonomous : full council + execution ARMED to read-only — `konsey do` still needs an
               explicit KONSEY_EXEC + confirm; NO posture ever grants a blind write.
cli.init.regime_preamble:
Data regime — a detection AID for clinical/identity terms, NOT a legal-compliance
guarantee (Article 4.3); liability stays with you. Press Enter for 'standard'.
cli.init.summary_audit: audit     : append-only trail at {db} — browse it with `konsey audit`
cli.init.noninteractive_notice: ! non-interactive stdin (piped install): using safe defaults (preset: {preset}). Re-run `konsey init` in a terminal to customize posture / owner / regime, or pass --preset / --locale to script it.

cli.enable.automation_explainer:
Background automation runs `dispatch tick` periodically via your OS scheduler:
it processes the dispatch inbox, runs due scheduled jobs, and runs the resilience
watchdog (reaps stalled runs, re-queues retriable work, escalates gated work to you).
The autonomy ceiling still holds — only public/internal runs unattended (Article 14).
Default OFF; reversible with `konsey uninstall --automation`.
